title: Necrophobia
description:
FeaturesRestart your social life at your new high school, Heaven's Gates Academy! 

~ Progress through 12 hours of story and achieve multiple endings! 

~ Stumble across 4 new faces, and become familiar with each new friend through their route!

~ Partake in a variety of different minigames with your newfound friends! 

~Unlock 10 different hand-drawn CGs as you all laugh, argue, cry, and most importantly, cooperate alongside one another!

Prove that which exists, or condemn that which shouldn't. Uncover the truth of Heaven's Gates Academy.

StoryLife has dealt you a less than stellar hand. You lived the majority of your days in solitude, existing amongst the crowd, but not being able to call anyone of them your own. Hopeful for the future, you seek for a change in scenery, and find it at your new high school- Heaven’s Gates Academy. Little by little as you take in the atmosphere, the more confident you feel in your decision. Moments later, a faithful encounter: The clumsy guy who made her drop all of her art supplies- the prettiest girl he had ever seen… Your mind was clear, and regret was but a word in your memory banks. Heaven’s Gates will be where you finally begin living, yet also where you may see with your own eyes the end of the line- as an unknown force traps you and your entire class within an infinite loop of the school. Unable to leave through any orthodox means, you must band together with your newfound friends and find an exit, while simultaneously avoiding the fate of those who fell before you, and ensuring the same for your comrades…

Characters

The cunning maiden, and the astounding artist- So graceful in appearance and mannerism, that she seemed right out of a fairy tale.

Kaelynn. Your sanctuary from the unknown~

Fanatic of all things music, and nigh unbearably extroverted life of the party- 

Chryssi. The most interesting girl you’ve ever met~

The beacon of sunshine, even where the sun itself cannot reach. 

Phoebe. The cutest little thing you’ve ever laid eyes on~

Brainiac, athletic, and star of the track team- If it wasn’t for his temper, he’d be a model student. 

Ixora. Just one of the guys~
description_short: Start your life anew at Heaven's Gates Academy. Learn new subjects, make new friends, experience what you've never before deemed possible. Change your fate, and the fate of those around you- your decisions matter greatly.
